quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Calamity pass on Gate 6 due to 2023 pre-tax charges on B-21 low-rate initial production fixed-price contracts and Section 174 amortization drag (5-year FCF conversion 54.9%). FY2025 FCF rebounded strongly to $3.3B+ backed by record $95.7B backlog. Operating ROIC normalized to 17.0% reflecting true physical capital efficiency across classified skunkworks, rocket testing, and aerospace assembly infrastructure (neutralizing an unrepresentative 46.88% mechanical tangible ROIC distorted by $15.5B Orbital ATK acquisition goodwill deductions; GAAP median ROIC is 14.03%). FY2022 peak Owner EPS of $31.4653 accepted as peak cycle earning power (FY2025 Owner EPS at $29.24 confirms post-charge normalization). Conservative through-the-cycle growth calibrated to 6.5% reflecting 3.0% B-21 bomber ramp, 2.5% space/missile defense volume, 1.5% pricing/escalation, with a conservative -1.5% deduction for fixed-price friction and overruns, plus 1.0% share repurchases. Solid balance sheet with net debt of 2.57x NI ($10.76B net debt on $4.18B NI). At $539.07 (17.13x peak Owner EPS), NOC trades slightly Above PAR (+3.1% vs PAR Value of $522.80, PAR Multiple 16.61x) with an expected 5Y IRR of 7.5%.
